newsitem.title: USA: Norwest raises prime rate to 8.50 pct.
newsitem.headline: Norwest raises prime rate to 8.50 pct.

text.p: Norwest Corp raised its prime lending rate to 8.50 percent from 8.25 percent effective March 26, the bank said Tuesday.
The move follows a decision by the Federal Reserve to raise the federal funds rate by 25 basis points and to leave the discount unchanged.

Tuesday's prime rate rises mark the first time banks have raised their lending rates in over two years. The Fed last altered monetary policy on January 31, 1996, when it lowered both the federal funds rate and the discount rate by 25 basis points.
